description_en: Retrieves the current service details of a hotline agent by agent account
description_zh: 根据坐席账号获取热线坐席当前服务详情
name: GetHotlineAgentDetail

parameters.help_en: The unique client request ID for idempotence checks. You can use a UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of AICCS. You can find this ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The account name of the agent, which is unique within the instance (logon name)
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，实例内唯一（登录名）
parameters.name: account_name

AgentStatus.description_en: The agent status. Valid values: 1 to 6

AgentStatusCode.description_en:
The agent status code. Valid values:
1: AgentCheckout (agent checked out)
3: AgentReady (agent idle)
4: AgentBreak (agent on break)
5: AgentAcw (after-call work)
6: AgentBusyForCall (on a call)
AgentStatusCode.description_zh:
坐席状态编码
1:AgentCheckout（坐席下班）
3:AgentReady（坐席空闲）
4:AgentBreak（坐席小休）
5:AgentAcw（话后处理）
6:AgentBusyForCall（通话中）

Assigned.description_en:
Indicates whether the agent is assigned. Valid values:
false: Not assigned (no active call).
true: Assigned (active call)
Assigned.description_zh:
是否被分配，有以下枚举：
false：未分配（无通话）
true：已分配（有通话）

RestType.description_en:
The break type. Valid values:
1: Break.
2: Meal. 
3: Meeting. 
4: Coaching.
5: Training
RestType.description_zh:
小休类型，有以下枚举：
1：小休
2：就餐 
3：会议 
4：辅导
5：培训

TenantId.description_en: The ID of the tenant to which the agent belongs. This ID has a one-to-one mapping with the instance ID specified in the request parameters
TenantId.description_zh: 坐席所属的租户ID，与入参中的实例ID一一对应

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to trace the cause of an error
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于跟踪错误原因

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call was successful
